faqs.a:
Whenever in any section of this chapter, or rule or regulation promulgated hereunder,
               the doing of any act is required, prohibited, or declared to be unlawful and no definite
               fine or penalty is provided for a violation thereof, any person, firm, or corporation
               who shall be convicted of a violation of any such section shall, for each offense,
               be punished by a fine not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 19-3; Ord. No. 2208, § 1, 9-16-1985; Ord. No. 2297, § 10, 5-5-1986)
